channel.title: Trends Incoming
channel.description: Your curator for what's trending right now

item.title: The Brewers are going to the World Series. Here's why that's a big deal.
item.description: Milwaukee swept the two-time champion Dodgers to reach its first World Series since 1982. What happened, why it's trending, and how to watch Game 1 on Oct 23.

item.title: You Can See Everything: Nathan Fielder's Elizabeth Holmes movie, explained (no spoilers)
item.description: A24's documentary opens Oct 16. What it is, why it's the most talked-about doc of the year, and how to see it without getting spoiled.

item.title: Olivia Rodrigo and Chappell Roan's "expectations" remix: what to know
item.description: Olivia's first remix, Chappell's first feature, and a game-show video hosted by David Byrne. What it is, why it's everywhere, and where to listen.

item.title: Social Security COLA 2027 is official: 3.6%
item.description: SSA confirmed a 3.6% COLA for 2027. What it is, when it hits checks, earnings limits, and where to follow it.

item.title: Dodgers vs. Brewers NLCS: why baseball owns your feed right now
item.description: The NLCS has Dodgers, Brewers, Snell and Dave Roberts trending nationwide. What the series is, why it's loud, and where to follow it.

item.title: Street Fighter opens Friday: your weekend movie guide
item.description: Paramount's live-action Street Fighter hits theaters Oct 16. Cast, what it is, and how to follow the opening weekend buzz.

item.title: Medicare open enrollment starts today: a no-panic starter guide
item.description: Oct 15–Dec 7 is the window to compare 2027 Medicare Advantage and Part D plans. What you can change, deadlines, and where to look.

item.title: GTA VI is five weeks away. Here's everything that's actually confirmed.
item.description: GTA VI launches Nov 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. What it is, why it's trending, the long road here, and what happens next.

item.title: The 2026 midterms, explained without the spin
item.description: Nov 3, 2026: every House seat, 35 Senate races and 36 governorships. A neutral guide to what's at stake, what the polls show and how to follow it.

item.title: Why everyone wants the Zelda Switch 2 (and how to actually get one)
item.description: Nintendo's Zelda 40th Anniversary Switch 2 drops Oct 29 for $519.99. What it is, why it sold out, and what's next.

item.title: Greta Gerwig's Narnia trailer is here, and it's not what you expected
item.description: Netflix dropped the first trailer for Narnia: The Magician's Nephew. What it is, why it's trending, and the release plan.

item.title: The "Six Seven" dance: why your whole feed is counting on its fingers
item.description: The Six Seven dance is October's biggest TikTok trend. What it is, how J-Hope sent it viral, and how to join in.

item.title: Hormuz, the Houthis and why a strip of water matters to your gas tank
item.description: A neutral explainer on the Saudi–Houthi escalation and tension around the Strait of Hormuz, and why it's trending.

item.title: Gemini 4 Argon, Muse Wonder and Maia 300: the AI week, explained
item.description: Google, Meta and Microsoft all made big AI moves in one week. What launched, why it's trending, and what to watch.

item.title: The Oct 31 funding deadline: a neutral guide to the shutdown talk
item.description: Congress must fund the government by Oct 31. What's at stake, where the parties stand, and what happens next.

item.title: Zelda 40th Anniversary Switch 2
item.description: Nintendo's first special-edition Switch 2. Triforce dock, green and gold Joy-Con, $519.99. Under two weeks to go, and finding stock is still the real boss fight.

item.title: Ocarina of Time remake
item.description: The N64 legend, rebuilt for Switch 2. Real jump button, free camera, and yes, you can hum into the mic.

item.title: GTA VI
item.description: Under five weeks out. Preload opens Nov 12. The internet is already counting the minutes.

item.title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer is a hit
item.description: Ten days after launch, reviewers are calling it one of the best racing games in years, and Steam players are still lining up for podracer and speeder chaos.

item.title: VisionQuest on Disney+
item.description: Paul Bettany is back as Vision and James Spader's Ultron is in his head. Episodes 1 and 2 dropped Oct 13, with new ones on Tuesdays.

item.title: Girls is coming back to HBO
item.description: Lena Dunham is reviving Girls for five episodes, and Allison Williams, Jemima Kirke, Zosia Mamet and Andrew Rannells are all back. Production starts in 2027, a decade after the finale.

item.title: Helluva Boss S3 (and Stolas)
item.description: Prime Video weekly drops; Stolas is trending hard on X. Part 1 finale lands Oct 28.

item.title: You Can See Everything opens today
item.description: Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim's A24 documentary follows Elizabeth Holmes in the weeks before she reported to prison. Critics are raving, it runs 2 hr 55 min, and it pulled about $2M in previews.

item.title: Street Fighter hits theaters
item.description: It's opening day. Paramount's live-action Street Fighter made about $4M in Thursday previews and is tracking for a $30M-plus weekend. Andrew Koji is Ryu, Noah Centineo is Ken.

item.title: Narnia: The Magician's Nephew trailer
item.description: Greta Gerwig's Narnia, scored to Stairway to Heaven, with Meryl Streep voicing Aslan. Big swing. Our take: it works.

item.title: Other Mommy won last weekend
item.description: Jessica Chastain horror, D-plus CinemaScore, $27.5M opening anyway. This weekend it has to hold off Street Fighter.

item.title: The Pinterest vibe check
item.description: Search singer, vinyl, season and character on Pinterest, screenshot the first image for each, and post the grid. It's your algorithm's read on you, in four squares, and it's weirdly accurate.

item.title: Olivia Rodrigo x Chappell Roan "expectations"
item.description: Olivia's first-ever remix and Chappell's first-ever feature, out now. The video is a retro game show hosted by David Byrne. Yes, really.

item.title: Taylor Swift's "Patient Zero"
item.description: Second straight week at No. 1 on the Hot 100. Her 16th chart-topper. TikTok is using it for wedding edits.

item.title: Drake & Don Toliver debut at No. 5
item.description: New collab, straight into the Hot 100 top 5. Also on that chart: ADÉLA's first top 10.

item.title: "we fell in love in october"
item.description: girl in red's song is still one of the fastest-climbing TikTok sounds, with 2M+ videos. Peak fall.

item.title: Grammy nominations
item.description: The 2027 nominees drop Monday, Nov 16. The ceremony is Feb 7 on ABC, Disney+ and Hulu.

item.title: Brewers sweep the Dodgers
item.description: Milwaukee is going to the World Series for the first time since 1982. They swept the two-time champs, capped by a 6-4 comeback in Game 4 on Garrett Mitchell's go-ahead homer.

item.title: ALCS: Guardians lead Rays 2-1
item.description: Rookie Petey Halpin's go-ahead homer (and very large bat flip) won Game 3, 3-2. Game 4 is tonight in Cleveland. The winner of this series gets the Brewers.

item.title: NBA opening night
item.description: Tuesday! Knicks raise the banner, LeBron debuts for Philly, and NBC has the first-ever opening tripleheader.

item.title: NHL: where to watch
item.description: 84-game season, split between ESPN and TNT. Heritage Classic Oct 25.

item.title: Bills 37, Rams 34 (OT)
item.description: A blocked field goal, then a walk-off kick. Josh Allen's first career OT win. Super Bowl preview? Maybe.

item.title: Google Gemini 4 Argon
item.description: Google's new frontier model, out Oct 13 with a 1M-token window. It's pitched as less hedgy and less cliché.

item.title: Open-source AI keeps moving
item.description: Frontier labs went closed this week (hello, Muse Wonder). Open-weight models and small labs are still the other half of the story.

item.title: Meta Muse Wonder
item.description: Meta's first frontier model. Not open-weight this time, which is a big shift from Llama.

item.title: Microsoft Maia 300 chip
item.description: Microsoft's third in-house AI chip. The pitch: 40% better performance per megawatt. Deployment is planned for 2027.

item.title: iPhone Duo pre-orders
item.description: Apple's first foldable. $1,999. Pre-orders open today at 5 a.m. PT (8 a.m. ET) and it arrives Oct 23. Apple doesn't show stock ahead of time, so check your delivery date at checkout.

item.title: Copper & cherry-cola hair
item.description: Pinterest's first Beauty Trend Report says hair is going warm and moody: mocha, copper, cherry cola.

item.title: Ghost Rose nails
item.description: Milky, blush-nude nails beating burgundy this fall. Quiet but very chic.

item.title: Smoky eyes + burgundy lips
item.description: Clean girl is taking a night off. Runways from Saint Laurent to Gucci brought the smoke back.

item.title: Taco Bell x Milk Bar Birthday Cake Empanada
item.description: Out now nationwide. Cake-flavored empanada with pink frosting and sprinkles. $3.49. Chaotic in the best way.

item.title: Wingstop x Sour Patch Kids wings
item.description: Wings in a sour-then-sweet glaze. We're scared. We're also going.

item.title: Dunkin' Spider Donut is back
item.description: The Halloween Spider Donut returns, plus a purple Berry Battie drink.

item.title: Popeyes x Megan Thee Stallion
item.description: A new Honey Chicken Biscuit with a Megan Thee Stallion merch tie-in.

item.title: The "Six Seven" dance
item.description: A Brazilian funk track: count on your fingers, shrug on the drop. J-Hope did it and the top video hit 75M+ views.

item.title: Ramalama costume walk
item.description: A creepy low-angle shot zooms out to reveal the Halloween fit, set to Róisín Murphy. Easy to copy, hard to stop watching.

item.title: Pumpkin Head Illusion
item.description: Hold a pumpkin up to the lens and congratulations, you're a pumpkin. Spooky-season gold.

item.title: AI cat melodrama
item.description: Synthetic cats acting out family dramas and tiny tragedies. Weirdly emotional, and a fast-breaking format.

item.title: Midterms: 18 days out
item.description: Every House seat, 35 Senate races and 36 governor races are on the ballot Nov 3. New polls cut both ways: Marist has Turek (D) up 48-45 in Iowa, and Wedgewood has Hyde-Smith (R) up 52-48 in Mississippi. Both leads are inside the margin of error.

item.title: Oct 31 government funding deadline
item.description: Congress has 15 days to fund federal agencies. The sticking points are policy riders, including DHS immigration-enforcement provisions. Republican and Democratic leaders each say the other side's terms are the obstacle.

item.title: Lame-duck to-do list
item.description: After the election, Congress gets about 24 legislative days. On the list: funding past Dec 11, the defense policy bill, and farm and surveillance reauthorizations.

item.title: SCOTUS: Beaird v. United States
item.description: Can courts still defer to Sentencing Commission commentary after Loper Bright? Justices from both wings sounded skeptical of changing the rule. A decision is due by July.

item.title: SCOTUS: Salazar v. Paramount Global
item.description: This week's argument asked how far the Video Privacy Protection Act reaches. It matters for every site that embeds video.

item.title: 850+ drones hit Ukraine in a day
item.description: Zelenskyy says Russia launched more than 850 drones in roughly a day. One hit a supermarket near Odesa, injuring four people.

item.title: Saudi–Houthi fighting escalates
item.description: Houthi strikes hit Riyadh's airport (at least 13 killed) and an Aramco building. Saudi-led coalition airstrikes hit Sanaa. Several airlines have suspended flights to the region.

item.title: Strait of Hormuz tension
item.description: Analysts say Iran appears to be targeting ship-to-ship oil transfers near the strait. Brent crude is still above $105.

item.title: Tesla x SpaceX merger talk
item.description: A Barclays note says a Tesla-SpaceX merger could be announced before Tesla's December annual meeting, and Musk's "Tesla x SpaceX" post poured fuel on it. Nothing has been announced.

item.title: FMC plunges 31%
item.description: The crop-chemicals maker slashed its Q3 outlook, blaming weak demand, pricey inventory sitting with distributors and cheaper generics. Shares hit a multi-decade low.

item.title: Barclays cools on Dell and HPE
item.description: Barclays cut both to hold, questioning when enterprise AI spending really shows up. Dell fell 6.8% and HPE 7.1% on Oct 15.

item.title: Bumble to be acquired for $1.3B
item.description: The dating-app company agreed to an all-cash deal with Ithaca Holdings, according to its SEC filing.

item.title: Social Security COLA is 3.6%
item.description: It's official: Social Security and SSI rise 3.6% in 2027. About 76 million Americans. SS payable January 2027; SSI from Dec 31, 2026. Taxable max $192,300. Biggest bump in three years.

item.title: Medicare open enrollment is open
item.description: Oct 15 through Dec 7: compare 2027 Medicare Advantage and Part D plans. Changes take effect Jan 1. Different from HealthCare.gov open enrollment (that opens Nov 1).

item.title: Mortgage rates hold at 7.40%
item.description: Freddie Mac's 30-year average didn't budge this week and is still at a three-year high. The next reading is Thursday, Oct 22.

item.title: Flu shot: aim for end of October
item.description: CDC says everyone 6 months and older should get a flu shot, ideally by the end of October. People 65+ should get the high-dose types.

item.title: COVID vaccine guidance
item.description: CDC's current COVID shot guidance is a shared decision with your provider. It's especially important for 65+ and high-risk people.

item.title: Porsche Mission S
item.description: Porsche revealed a mid-engined super sports car concept on the same Queens pier where the 550 Spyder debuted in 1953. A production version will sit above the 911. Engine and price: not announced.

item.title: Ford's 4.38M-vehicle recall
item.description: A trailer-brake-control recall covering F-Series, Ranger, Maverick and Lincoln models. Check your VIN.

item.title: Jeep & Wagoneer TPMS recall
item.description: About 202,000 SUVs whose tire-pressure monitors may not warn you.

item.title: The 12-foot Skelly returns
item.description: Home Depot's giant skeleton is back, now with app-controlled moves and LCD eyes. $299 original, $379 upgraded.

item.title: Cats are catching up
item.description: Dogs still lead at 88.9M to 77M cats, but more US households now own kittens than puppies.

item.title: Cat vet visits up, dog visits down
item.description: Feline clinic visits rose 2.7% in Q3 while dog visits fell.

item.title: The 2027–28 FAFSA is open
item.description: It went live Sept 23, the earliest launch ever. Some aid is first-come, first-served, so file early.

item.title: Peak leaf season
item.description: New England is peaking now. The Midwest and Mid-Atlantic follow mid-to-late October, and the Southeast peaks into early November.

item.title: Santa Ana red flag warning
item.description: Hot, dry Santa Ana winds have Southern California under a red flag warning through Saturday night, with power shutoffs in parts of Malibu. Any spark can spread fast.

item.title: Atlantic is quiet (for now)
item.description: NHC showed no active Atlantic storms and none expected for 7 days as of Oct 14. Nine named storms so far this season.

item.title: Blueface proposes to Chrisean Rock
item.description: A nightclub proposal in Scottsdale, complete with a bottle-girl sign. She said yes.

item.title: Pauly D is engaged
item.description: The Jersey Shore star and Nikki Hall got engaged in Vegas after six years together.

item.title: Tobey Maguire officiates ex's wedding
item.description: Jennifer Meyer married Geoffrey Ogunlesi in Hawaii, and her ex Tobey Maguire officiated. Peak co-parenting energy.

item.title: Hinge is eating Tinder's lunch
item.description: Hinge's payers grew 17% while Tinder's fell 5%. Dating is shifting from swipes to intentional.

item.title: App fatigue is real
item.description: Reviewers say singles want fewer swipes and more verified, IRL-first apps.

item.title: #CityTasteTest
item.description: Honest local food reviews, city by city. TikTok's favorite format this month for small spots.

item.title: Format fragmentation
item.description: No single mega-challenge this month. Instead, lots of micro-trends: costume transitions, K-pop revivals, cat edits.

item.title: $TSLA is all over X
item.description: Tesla is trending after the Barclays merger note and Musk's Roadster livestream. Shares barely moved after hours. Not advice.

item.title: Moderna keeps climbing
item.description: Shares rose about 4.5% to $236.50 as investors wait for detailed Phase 3 melanoma vaccine data with Merck. Big run, big expectations. Not advice.

item.title: Dow hits a one-month high
item.description: The Dow rose 1.08% on Oct 15, led by Nike, Salesforce and Home Depot. The S&P 500 added 0.33% and the Nasdaq 0.08%.

item.title: Bryson Fire in the Malibu hills
item.description: A brush fire near Encinal Canyon grew to about 200 acres overnight with 0% containment. Evacuation orders and warnings are in place, and a shelter is open at Agoura High School.

item.title: Open enrollment 2027
item.description: HealthCare.gov opens Nov 1. Enroll by Dec 15 for Jan 1 coverage. It closes Jan 15.

item.title: SpaceX CRS-35 docked at the ISS
item.description: Dragon arrived Oct 15 with 6,300+ lbs of cargo, including the station's final roll-out solar arrays.

item.title: Artemis III booster stacked
item.description: NASA finished stacking the boosters for the Moon-landing mission, with all four RS-25 engines installed.

item.title: Gulf flights paused
item.description: Delta, Lufthansa, Air France-KLM and Qatar Airways were among the airlines that suspended flights to Saudi Arabia and nearby countries after strikes on Riyadh's airport. Check your airline before you go.
